tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on Sewage treatment plant: it starts an enquiry with human providers who quote directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms.

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of the Sewage treatment plant enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to Sewage treatment plant: NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show the person the summary and the consent line. Step 2: only if the person agrees, call again with the same answers, consent=true and the confirmation token; the enquiry is then submitted, and the person receives an email with a link they must click before any provider sees it. Consent means the person has read and agreed to: "Send my contact details to up to three relevant local drainage engineers, chosen by Sewage treatment plant, who'll contact me directly. I'll be emailed each firm's name as my details go to it, and can stop any more firms getting them."

answers.description: the person's answers, keyed by field key

consent.description: true only when the person has agreed to: Send my contact details to up to three relevant local drainage engineers, chosen by Sewage treatment plant, who'll contact me directly. I'll be emailed each firm's name as my details go to it, and can stop any more firms getting them.

confirmation.description: the confirmation token from step 1, after the person has approved the summary
